title: Workspace Sentinel — modular sidebar, route scaffolding, and cross-workspace routing
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a modular sidebar and routing scaffold to support fast workspace switching, persistent dashboard anchors (cost, rollouts, model telemetry), and progressive disclosure for teams with multiple orgs. Focus on tactile affordances for quick context changes, keyboard-first flows, and clear signal for canary vs stable rollouts. Deliver prototypes for desktop and narrow / collapsed variants, annotated handoff specs, and an accessibility review.
acceptance_criteria: Composable sidebar components documented in Figma with tokenized spacing and states
Prototype supports keyboard nav, command-palette jump, and 1-click workspace pinning
Route schema defined for deep links to dashboards/rollouts/cost-lenses with backward-compatible redirects
Developer-facing spec (paths, query params) added to console API doc
Usability test with 6 PM/SE participants shows 80% success on workspace swap & open rollout view in <= 6s
decisions: Use compact pinned-workspace chips at top of rail instead of full workspace list to reduce cognitive load
Adopt route pattern /workspace/:id/(dashboard|rollouts|costs)/:lens for deep linking
Preserve current command-palette shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K) as canonical jumper; expose workspace index there
When in Dedicated mode show capacity ribbon above rollouts to surface SLAs
tradeoffs: Full workspace list on rail increases vertical size and harms density for customers with >12 workspaces; tradeoff accepted for chip-based quick pinning + workspace modal for full search
Aggressive prefetch of cost lenses can increase billing queries — decided to lazy-load and cache per-session
prototypes: Desktop collapsed rail prototype (Figma frame ID: 42)
Narrow viewport interaction flow (Figma frame ID: 58)
usability_notes: Early micro-testing: users expect workspace switch to be instantaneous; implement optimistic UI to mask network latency
Users confused by identical workspace avatars — add name initials + color strip for quick recognition
next_steps: Finalize accessibility contrast pass and ARIA roles for rail items
Engineering spike to validate route redirects and legacy deep link compatibility (ENG-20560)
Prepare canary cohort and telemetry metrics (eng + pm sync)
